en: Multiview color postcard showing the Romanian spa resort Băile Felix near Oradea: modernist hotels, thermal outdoor pools crowded with bathers, and a lotus pond. The front title reads "ORADEA – BAILE FELIX." The reverse has a handwritten Romanian message dated 3 Aug. 1978, a 40 B "POSTA ROMANA" stamp (DENSUS) and a Bucharest circular postmark dated 05.08.78. Addressed to a family in București. Publisher imprint Editura Meridiane with price 1,50 lei and photo credits.
